trimmedBy: node trim-muse-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by id, regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: A page past page_count answers HTTP 400 {"code": 400, "error": "Value `page` is too high"} - NOT an empty result list as the developer page says ("Out-of-range pages return 0 results"). Kept whole. Terms (https://www.themuse.com/developers/api/v2/terms, read 2026-10-24): section 2.2 requires the app to be REGISTERED through the developer portal before it accesses the API; section 3.1 grants a limited, revocable right to use Muse Content "to the extent needed to format and display Muse Content through the Apps"; section 3.4 requires displayed content to link back to www.themuse.com; section 3.3(g) forbids cloning Muse Content; section 4.3(d) forbids scraping the website; section 4.2 forbids exceeding rate limits (500 requests/hour without a key, 3600 with one, per the developer page). Nothing in the terms addresses storing postings in an applicant-tracking database, and no registered app exists for this CRM, so permission to ingest is UNCLEAR. robots.txt (User-agent *) does not disallow /api/public/. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
